prompt: A creator was paid twice for the same month. The duplicate came from a payout file that was approved two times. We need to recover the money.
Refunds take up to ten working days to reach the customer's bank. Most of the delay is on the bank's side, not ours.
An invoice was generated with the wrong VAT number. The customer needs a credit note and a corrected invoice.
The monthly payout run starts on the first working day. Approvals close two days later, and the period locks after that.
A webhook returned 500 errors for an hour last night. Orders placed in that window were not tracked.
Our API returns 429 when a client sends more than five requests in ten seconds. Clients should wait and retry.
A merchant asked why their dashboard shows fewer sales than their own shop. The difference comes from returns that we deduct.
Bank details failed validation because the IBAN had a space at the end. The form now trims it before checking.
Latency on the large model doubled after the release. The team traced it to a missing cache on model weights.
A customer exceeded their monthly quota on the twentieth. They asked whether they can raise it without changing plans.
Two accounts belong to the same person. They want them merged without losing their payout history.
The tracking link broke for one market because the URL was longer than the network allows. Shorter links fixed it.
